The `blowhorn diagnostics` commands. Each one's `--help` prints the same text.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`diagnostics bundle`](#blowhorn-diagnostics-bundle) | Collect a private, redacted support package locally. |
| [`diagnostics bundle-preview`](#blowhorn-diagnostics-bundle-preview) | Show every JSON file in a local support archive and its approval checksum. |
| [`diagnostics case-prepare`](#blowhorn-diagnostics-case-prepare) | Prepare one feedback point and bind it to the exact reviewed package checksum. |
| [`diagnostics case-send`](#blowhorn-diagnostics-case-send) | Upload the approved support package and feedback to Cloud. |

## blowhorn diagnostics bundle

Collect a private, redacted support package locally. Nothing is uploaded. Read only the selected scoped log directory, never other accounts or browser profiles.

```text
blowhorn diagnostics bundle [OPTIONS]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | string |  | New private directory to create; must not exist. |
| `--log-dir` | string |  | The single scoped log directory to inspect. |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` | Emit machine-readable JSON output |

Examples:

```bash
blowhorn diagnostics bundle --log-dir ./data/logs/machine --output ./support-review --json
```

Output: json with `--json`, text otherwise.

## blowhorn diagnostics bundle-preview

Show every JSON file in a local support archive and its approval checksum. No upload. Inspect this exact preview before approving a transfer.

```text
blowhorn diagnostics bundle-preview [OPTIONS]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--file` | string |  | Local support.tgz to inspect. |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` | Emit machine-readable JSON output |

Examples:

```bash
blowhorn diagnostics bundle-preview --file ./support-review/support.tgz --json
```

Output: json with `--json`, text otherwise.

## blowhorn diagnostics case-prepare

Prepare one feedback point and bind it to the exact reviewed package checksum. Writes private retry state; sends nothing.

```text
blowhorn diagnostics case-prepare [OPTIONS]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--file` | string |  | Reviewed local support.tgz. |
| `--feedback-file` | string |  | Reviewed JSON containing one feedback point and reply preference. |
| `--state-file` | string |  | New private retry state file, never share it. |
| `--approve-sha256` | string |  | Exact SHA256 shown by bundle-preview. |
| `--api-base` | string |  | Approved HTTPS Cloud origin, without path. |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` | Emit machine-readable JSON output |

Examples:

```bash
blowhorn diagnostics case-prepare --file ./support-review/support.tgz --feedback-file ./feedback.json --state-file ./support-review/case.json --approve-sha256 SHA256 --api-base https://cloud.blowhorn.ai --json
```

Output: json with `--json`, text otherwise.

## blowhorn diagnostics case-send

Upload the approved support package and feedback to Cloud. Requires both preview checksums; preserves private state for safe retry.

```text
blowhorn diagnostics case-send [OPTIONS]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--state-file` | string |  | Private case retry state file. |
| `--approve-sha256` | string |  | Approved archive digest. |
| `--approve-feedback-sha256` | string |  | Exact request digest from case-prepare. |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` | Emit machine-readable JSON output |

Examples:

```bash
blowhorn diagnostics case-send --state-file ./support-review/case.json --approve-sha256 SHA256 --approve-feedback-sha256 FEEDBACK_SHA256 --json
```

Output: json with `--json`, text otherwise.
